messages:
carter_newhire: Hey folks, first-week benefits/payroll brain dump 8242024. Quick Qs: 1) I started 2026-08-23 1 when does medical/dental take effect? 2) I listed my partner as dependent during offer 1 what docs do you need for domestic-partner coverage? 3) Employer HSA contribution 1 pro-rated? 4) Small travel expense ($42 Uber) for onboarding site visit 1 how to expense? 5) State tax residency 1 do I need to update anything if I moved from NJ to NY recently?

sophie (People Ops): Welcome Carter! :wave: Short bullets: 1) Standard effective date = first of the month after 30 days from start, so with 8/23 start your coverage effective date would be 2026-10-01 unless you selected expedited during enrollment. 2) Domestic partner docs: we need a signed domestic partner affidavit + proof of joint residence or shared finances (one of: utility, lease, bank statement) dated within the last 90 days. Upload to Rippling under Dependents or email benefits@redwood.com. 3) Yes, HSA employer contribution is pro-rated by coverage effective date. 4) Onboarding travel: use Ramp (Onboarding - Travel) or the Google expense form if you don't have Ramp. 5) State tax: update your state withholding in Rippling and upload an NY IT-2104 if applicable; payroll needs that before the first run to adjust withholding.

carter_newhire: thanks 1 for the partner docs 1 is a notarized affidavit required or just signed?

ben (Benefits): Notarization not required for most carriers; a signed domestic partner affidavit + one supporting document is generally enough. We'll confirm with the carrier after you submit. If the carrier requests anything extra we'll loop you in.

alec_finance: Expense steps: 1) If you have Ramp: create expense, category = "Onboarding - Travel", attach receipt (photo), note the date and trip purpose. 2) If no Ramp: use the Google expense form (https://forms.gle/expense-redwood) and cc finance@redwood.com. Example memo we accept: 

"Expense: Airport -> office Uber | Amount: $42.00 | Date: 2026-08-23 | Category: Onboarding - Travel | Notes: First-week onboarding site visit"

alec_finance: Turnaround about 3 business days; reimbursement posts on next payroll unless marked urgent.

carter_newhire: HSA pro-rate question 1 if coverage effective 10/01 will I get a partial employer contribution in the first month or is it spread across payrolls?

ben (Benefits): Employer HSA contribution for 2026 is $600 for single ($1,200 family). It's pro-rated based on coverage effective date and posted to your HSA account within ~2 pay cycles after coverage starts. It may appear as a lump or in the first few deposits depending on the HSA custodian. Finance shows the payroll memo when it posts.

mike_payroll: Payroll notes: semi-monthly runs on the 15th and last day. Since your start was 8/23, your 8/31 pay includes prorated earnings for 8/23-8/31. Any reimbursements approved after payroll cutoff go on the next run. For state tax: update Rippling ASAP (NY forms) so withholding is correct for the 9/15 run. If you need immediate confirmation tag payroll in Rippling and we'll verify.

carter_newhire: one more on benefits enrollment deadlines 1 i think i missed the 14-day window? are there penalties or defaults i should worry about?

sophie (People Ops): If you miss the 14-day enrollment window, the system may default you to the company's base plan for insurance. We can often process a manual enrollment if carrier deadlines allow, but you must email benefits@redwood.com with the plan choices and start date. We try to avoid forcing defaults, so reach out now and we'll assist.

hr-bot: Automated reminder: New hire benefits enrollment due by 2026-09-06. Complete elections in Rippling to avoid default plan assignment.

carter_newhire: sweet 1 thanks all. i'll upload partner docs and submit the Uber receipt now. Appreciate the clear steps :thumbsup:
